title: Estimation of the input-to-state stability gain functions from finite-dimensional approximations
summary: Since the concept of input-to-state stability (ISS) was introduced, it has been extensively investigated for finite-dimensional control systems and has recently received attention for infinite-dimensional systems. While numerical techniques provide a bridge between these two worlds, a rigorous connection between the ISS of an infinite-dimensional system with an unbounded control operator and the properties of its finite-dimensional approximations has not yet been established.
